name: HWR_SLEEP_PTRN
description: The sleep pattern table stores user sleep pattern data.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key for the wellness user table.

columns.name: SLEEP_PATTERN_DATE
columns.description: This is the date of the sleep pattern.

columns.name: COLOR
columns.description: This is the color of the sleep pattern.

columns.name: BED_TIME
columns.description: This is the total bed time of the sleep pattern.

columns.name: SLEEP_TIME
columns.description: This is the total sleep time of the sleep pattern.

columns.name: AWAKE_TIME
columns.description: This is the total awake time of the sleep pattern.

columns.name: SLEEP_NUMBER
columns.description: This is the sleep number of the sleep pattern.

columns.name: SCORE
columns.description: This is the score of the sleep pattern.

columns.name: WAKENINGS
columns.description: This is the number of wakenings of the sleep pattern.

columns.name: LOCATION
columns.description: This is the location of the sleep pattern.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID
columns.description: This is the source id of the sleep pattern.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
